about: Every button the mod listens to. Keyboard keys are read with GetAsyncKeyState; controller buttons from the XInputGetState hook. While a binding is held, the game does not see those buttons (hooks.input).

columns.controller: XInput buttons held together (XINPUT_GAMEPAD_* names, LEFT_TRIGGER/RIGHT_TRIGGER for the triggers, + joins a chord); in-world rows can be rebound by the player in the Controls page
columns.when: in_world, grace (resting at a Site of Grace), menu (our menu open)
columns.verified: pressed in game and saw the effect

rows.action: Swing: Deku's Black Whip or Luffy's stretched arm. Hold to swing from what it catches ahead and above; Deku with an enemy locked on (or close in front) pulls himself in for a flying kick. Goku: Instant Transmission. Asta, in the air: the Blade Glider
open the JUMP FORCE menu (fighter select / loadout)
open the Controls page (rebind the ability buttons) from the fighter select
1.2.0: open the Move List (every fighter's combo tree and movement) from the fighter select
open the Build page (spend free attribute points) from the fighter select
change the boss difficulty (Easy / Normal / Hard) in the fighter select
change the boss warnings (Off / Text / Visual / All) in the fighter select
Training on or off in the fighter select: the enemy you lock onto becomes a punching bag that shows every hit
